subject: MAP: security checklist & DPA redlines — close plan
messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@blueriverbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@blueriver.com>, SecOps Team <secops@blueriver.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security checklist & DPA redlines — initial intake

Hi Irene / Jonas —

Thanks for taking this on. BlueRiver is trying to lock the platform selection and get legal/infosec comfortable before we finalize our SOW. High level ask: we need a short mutual action plan that lays out the security/compliance gates (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA + data retention expectations) and a realistic close timeline so procurement can schedule the purchase order and signatures.

What we can provide right now: a brief SOC 2 summary and our security questionnaire answers. I27m attaching a note that summarizes current gaps we want to validate. We27d like to target a contract signature by 2027-08-12 if possible.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, BlueRiver-security-ask.txt (see inline)

Key questions from BlueRiver SecOps / Legal:
- Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report within the last 12 months?
- Can Redwood accept the DPA redline we27re sending (attached)? Specific ask: limit data retention for customer-identifiable logs to 24 months and allow export on request.
- Can you provide a SIG/CAIQ snapshot or completed CAIQ in 3-5 business days?

If you can send a short MAP with checkpoints for evidence handoff (SOC2, CAIQ, DPA redline, data-retention clause), procurement will schedule signature. Please cc legal when you reply.

Thanks,
Alice Gomez
Director, IT Security
BlueRiver Bank

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@blueriverbank.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security checklist & DPA redlines — initial intake

Alice — thanks for the clear ask. I27m attaching a one-page MAP we propose (map-timeline.xlsx) that breaks the work into 4 checkpoints and ties each to expected artifacts and owners. High level responses to your bullets below, and I27ve looped in Legal (Laura) and Engineering (Rishi) for the DPA/data questions.

Quick answers: 
- SOC 2: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II report generated within the last 12 months. We27ll attach an excerpt (SOC2-summary.pdf) for your initial review; the full report can be shared under NDA if needed.
- SIG/CAIQ: we can produce a completed CAIQ snapshot. Expect delivery within 3 business days after we finalize the MAP acceptance.
- DPA: we received your redline. Laura will review and propose limited edits. Key technical note from infra: our default retention for token-level request logs is 18 months, but we can configure a 24-month window for this engagement; we27ll document the export process.

Proposed MAP checkpoints (in map-timeline.xlsx):
1) Evidence intake (SOC 2 excerpt, CAIQ snapshot) — due within 3 business days (owner: BlueRiver secops / Redwood infosec)
2) DPA negotiation & redline — legal review and proposed edits (owner: Redwood Legal) — target 4 business days
3) Tech acceptance (retention export test, sample logs) — engineering validation (owner: Rishi) — target 5 business days after DPA alignment
4) Contract signature & procurement (owner: Procurement teams) — target close date 2027-08-12

Next steps: Laura, can you pick a few DPA edits we cannot accept and propose language? Rishi, please outline the retention export steps and a short checklist we can hand to BlueRiver. Alice — if the timeline in the MAP looks OK I27ll mark it accepted and we27ll start the evidence handoff.

Attachments: map-timeline.xlsx

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@blueriverbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security checklist & DPA redlines — initial intake

On Thu, Jul 22, 2027 at 2:02 PM, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alice — thanks for the clear ask. I27m attaching a one-page MAP we propose (map-timeline.xlsx) that breaks the work into 4 checkpoints and ties each to expected artifacts and owners.

Alice / team — I reviewed the DPA-redline-v2.docx you shared. A few practical notes and proposed language:
- Retention: we can accept a 24-month retention for customer-identifiable logs, provided there is an audit trail for access and a documented retention policy that applies equally to backups. Proposed clause: "Customer-identifiable logs will be retained for no longer than twenty-four (24) months; access to logs will be logged and auditable."
- Export & portability: we will add an operational playbook ensuring BlueRiver can request and receive a data export within 10 business days (subject to reasonable security checks).
- Subprocessors / disclosures: request clarification on subprocessors and region-specific storage (they mentioned EU workloads in the questionnaire). We will keep processing within the US region for this account unless otherwise instructed.

Please see the attached redline (DPA-redline-v2.docx). I noted three clauses we cannot accept as written (marked in the doc): indefinite liability carveouts, unlimited audit frequency, and a requirement to push logs to a BlueRiver-owned S3 bucket without an authenticated transfer process.

I will prepare a short draft that Laura/Procurement can accept to keep to the MAP timeline. Also uploading a DocuSign envelope for the non-technical SOW once the DPA language is acceptable.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@blueriverbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@blueriver.com>, SecOps Team <secops@blueriver.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security checklist & DPA redlines — initial intake

Irene / team — thanks for the rapid responses and the proposed MAP. We27ve reviewed Laura27s redline notes and can accept the retention clause as revised (24 months with audit trail) and the export timeline.

Committed deliverables from BlueRiver:
- SOC 2 Type II report (full) and a signed excerpt: will deliver within 2 business days.
- Completed SIG/CAIQ snapshot: delivery in 3 business days.
- Procurement will review the updated DPA and route the SOW for signature once the DPA edits are complete.

Action items / next steps:
- BlueRiver SecOps: upload SOC2 and CAIQ files to the Drive link (we27ll use the drive folder in related_links above).
- Redwood (Rishi): provide the retention export checklist and a short runbook for the export test (target: 5 business days after DPA sign-off).
- Laura / Procurement: please prepare the DocuSign envelope for the SOW once DPA language is agreed.

We27re aligned on the target signature date of 2027-08-12. If any of the owners see a hard blocker, flag it in thread and we27ll escalate.

Attachments: signed-SOW-stub.pdf (procurement will send full signed SOW after DPA)

Thanks,
Alice Gomez
Director, IT Security
BlueRiver Bank
